_readme: What bootstrap installs, per layer. Add a line here, run `aos update` (or bootstrap.ps1 -Layer base).
The two agent CLIs are not listed: both use their vendor's own installer, which auto-updates.
(winget's OpenAI.Codex was tried on 2026-09-27: without Developer Mode it cannot create the `codex` alias.)
The ChatGPT/Codex desktop app comes from the Microsoft Store (9PLM9XGG6VKS) and updates there.

base.why: git, plus Git Bash, which gives Claude Code its Bash tool
gh: PRs, issues and Actions from both agents, without an MCP server
PowerShell 7 (pwsh), MSI edition: the default MSIX edition can't see tools in AppData (codex, npm globals)
Python for scripts and the knowledge-base tools (py launcher)
uv/uvx: Python envs and tools without polluting the global Python
rg: the search tool both agents reach for first
jq: JSON on the command line (CLI --json outputs)
fzf: fuzzy picking in the terminal
delta: readable diffs when reviewing agent work
editor for reviewing diffs; hosts the Claude Code and Codex extensions

npm.name: ccusage
npm.why: local usage/limit reports and the Claude Code status line
